title: Cyber Matrix
tagline: This project uses a browser plug-in and website to make NFT mint and trade easier for Web 2.0 users
description:
There's huge demand from Web 2.0 users to NFT and other markets in Web 3.0 world.

Creators lack of monetization channels on the Web 2.0 sites and users are not satisfied to trade privacy with free content, they have strong desire to join, build and own communities (decentralization with centralized community leaders & 1000-true-fans theory by Kevin Kelly).

This project allows users to access Web 3.0 features on Web 2.0 sites.
how_its_made: This project uses TypeScript to build the browser plugin, and NextJS for the website and Solidity for smart contract. This project deployed smart contract to Polygon test net and facilitate users afford NFT features, also utilizes the Web3.js, Web3Modal to interact with MetaMask wallet and allow users to access Web 3 world.
